name: EFLeverVault
classificationNote: Upstream label missing; classified by keyword rules from the root-cause text.
rootCause: insufficient validation. Vulnerable code snippet: https://etherscan.io/address/0xe39fd820B58f83205Db1D9225f28105971c3D309#code#L310 https://etherscan.io/address/0xe39fd820B58f83205Db1D9225f28105971c3D309#code#L429 Attacker can directly call Flashloan with userData “0x307832” which is bytes “0x2” from balancer and set EFLeverVault as recipient to trigger _withdraw(loan_amount, fee_amount); to make vault retain enough ETH. Then attacker can call withdraw to drain out the ETH in L429.
